## Executed method and measurements

Load original native GLB (37475 vertices, 40623 triangles, nonwatertight); convert texture to vertex RGB; voxelize by subdivide at pitch .0085, pad by 8, grid 100x131x130, 55005 original shell voxels. For two variants perform spherical binary closing (radius 2 or 3 voxels), union with original shell, binary_fill_holes, largest connected component, Gaussian smoothing (sigma .85 or 1.5), marching cubes at .5, repair normals. Transfer colors by inverse-square weighted six nearest donor vertices with distance offset .003. Export and reload GLB; VTK real mesh offscreen renders at 0/45/90/135/180 degrees with orthographic scale .61.
